declarations.description:
A connected disclosure surface with shared borders, outside corners and animated panels.
Opening a panel closes its siblings unless `multiple` is set.
declarations.name: Accordion

cssProperties.description: Space between panels. Zero joins their borders and corners; a positive gap separates them into cards.
cssProperties.name: --c2-accordion--gap

cssProperties.description: Width of the outer frame and shared panel dividers.
cssProperties.name: --c2-accordion--border-width

cssProperties.description: Color of the outer frame and shared panel dividers.
cssProperties.name: --c2-accordion--border-color

cssProperties.description: Outside corner radius. With a positive gap, applies to every panel.
cssProperties.name: --c2-accordion--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Panel and chevron animation duration. Set to 0ms for instant toggling; respects reduced motion.
cssProperties.name: --c2-accordion--transition-duration

members.name: multiple
members.description: Allows several panels to remain expanded. All panels may be closed in either mode.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allows several panels to remain expanded. All panels may be closed in either mode.
